projects.title: VITALA Data Management Platform
projects.summary: Designed and implemented a complete Data Management Plan including governance, cybersecurity, ETL workflows, and traceability for a biomedical research organization.
projects.problem: Biomedical research data was fragmented across multiple systems with no standardized governance, leading to reproducibility issues and compliance risks. Experimental pipelines were manual and error-prone.
projects.approach: Led the design and implementation of a comprehensive Data Management Plan. Established data governance frameworks, cybersecurity protocols, and automated ETL processes. Created standardized workflows for NMR and MRI datasets with full traceability.
projects.impact: Improved data reliability and reproducibility across all research projects. Established compliance-ready governance framework. Reduced data retrieval time by 60% through optimized ETL pipelines.

projects.title: NMR/MRI Analysis Pipeline Automation
projects.summary: Automated analysis pipelines for NMR and MRI experimental datasets, ensuring reproducibility and standardized output reporting while improving processing speed by 4x.
projects.problem: Manual analysis of NMR and MRI datasets was time-consuming (4-6 hours per experiment), error-prone, and lacked standardization. Results were difficult to reproduce across different operators.
projects.approach: Built automated pipelines using Python and containerized workflows. Implemented standardized preprocessing, analysis, and reporting modules. Created a user-friendly interface for non-technical researchers to run analyses.
projects.impact: Reduced analysis time from 4-6 hours to under 1 hour (4x improvement). Achieved 99.5% reproducibility across experiments. Enabled researchers to focus on interpretation rather than manual processing.

projects.title: ML for Carcinogenic Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Developed machine learning algorithms to identify carcinogenic biomarkers and predict drug toxicity, contributing to faster and more accurate safety assessments.
projects.problem: Traditional biomarker identification and toxicity prediction relied on manual analysis and simple statistical methods, missing complex patterns and taking weeks to produce results.
projects.approach: Developed ensemble ML models combining random forests, gradient boosting, and neural networks. Implemented feature engineering pipelines for molecular descriptors. Created validation frameworks with cross-validation and external test sets.
projects.impact: Achieved 87% accuracy in biomarker identification and 82% accuracy in toxicity prediction. Reduced analysis time from weeks to days. Contributed to 3 peer-reviewed publications.

projects.title: AI Pain Detection in Rodent Models
projects.summary: Built an end-to-end data pipeline for brain imaging datasets and developed a classification model for pain detection in rats achieving 90%+ accuracy.
projects.problem: Pain assessment in preclinical research relied on subjective behavioral observations. Objective, scalable methods were needed to improve drug efficacy studies and reduce animal variability.
projects.approach: Built data pipelines for preprocessing fMRI and behavioral data. Developed deep learning classification models using CNN architectures. Implemented rigorous validation with held-out test sets and cross-lab validation.
projects.impact: Achieved 92% accuracy in pain state classification. Enabled objective pain assessment at scale. Pipeline processed 10x more subjects than manual methods. Results contributed to 2 publications.

projects.title: Electronic Nose for Health & Food Applications
projects.summary: Designed computational models for an electronic nose prototype, developing predictive models for wine differentiation with 95%+ accuracy and health monitoring applications.
projects.problem: Traditional chemical analysis for food quality and health monitoring was expensive, time-consuming, and required specialized equipment. A low-cost, rapid alternative was needed.
projects.approach: Designed signal processing pipelines for sensor arrays. Developed classification and regression models for odor identification and concentration prediction. Created real-time inference system for prototype demonstration.
projects.impact: Achieved 95%+ accuracy in wine differentiation tasks. Demonstrated feasibility for health monitoring use cases. Reduced analysis cost by 80% compared to traditional methods.

projects.title: Experimental Throughput Optimization
projects.summary: Led a process redesign initiative that increased experimental throughput by 8x, enabling faster iteration cycles and accelerated model validation.
projects.problem: Experimental bottlenecks limited the pace of research. Manual sample handling, sequential processing, and resource conflicts created delays in critical path experiments.
projects.approach: Conducted process mapping and bottleneck analysis. Redesigned workflows with parallel processing and automated scheduling. Implemented sample tracking system and resource optimization algorithms.
projects.impact: Increased throughput from 12 to 96 experiments per week (8x improvement). Reduced experiment wait time by 70%. Enabled faster iteration on ML model validation.

projects.title: Internal Data Analysis Software Product
projects.summary: Built and launched an internal data analysis software product with UX research and interface design, delivering results 4x faster and improving adoption across technical teams.
projects.problem: Researchers struggled with complex command-line tools for data analysis. High learning curve led to errors and underutilization of available capabilities.
projects.approach: Conducted user research with 15+ researchers. Designed and built web-based interface with guided workflows and visualizations. Iterated based on usability testing feedback.
projects.impact: Delivered results 4x faster than previous workflow. Achieved 85% team adoption within 3 months. Reduced training time from 2 weeks to 2 days.

projects.title: Enterprise Analytics & BI Transformation
projects.summary: Delivering data-driven strategy and BI transformation projects for multinational clients including Bimbo, Danone, and Suntory.
projects.problem: Enterprise clients needed to modernize their analytics capabilities, improve data governance, and build automated reporting systems to support decision-making at scale.
projects.approach: Led data strategy assessments and roadmap development. Designed and implemented data governance frameworks. Built automated analytics pipelines and self-service BI solutions.
projects.impact: Improved reporting efficiency by 60% for client organizations. Established data governance frameworks ensuring compliance. Enabled self-service analytics for 200+ business users.
